name: 1st Saturday Super Market
tagline: 1st Saturday Super Market in Apple Valley, California
description: 1st Saturday Super Market is a farmers market in 14999 Dale Evans Pkwy., CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
